sections.Profile:
Kingpin, developed by Capcom Coin-Op, Inc. in December 1996, is a rare pinball machine with a gangster theme. Designed by Mark Ritchie, the game features two flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball. Notably, only nine prototype units were produced before Capcom ceased its pinball operations, making Kingpin highly sought after among collectors.
